name: russian-teacher
description: Teach Russian to Spanish-speaking friends through scoped Telegram lessons, native quizzes, and progress tracking.

defaultPrompt: Prepara la próxima lección de ruso para mis amigos hispanohablantes.
Revisa el progreso de nuestro grupo y prepara un quiz de ruso.
interface.longDescription: Create Russian lessons with Spanish explanations, pronunciation help and examples. Schedule lessons and Telegram quiz polls in your authorized group and review quiz progress. The backend stores and publishes ChatGPT-authored content; it does not call a model API.
